Scope: road works, storm, sewer, potable water and TSE networks, electrical works, fence and gates, a bridge and landscaping. Contract value 86.8M SAR, 24 months.

Status at a glance

Progress is measured as physical % complete, weighted by budgeted man-hours. At 73.4% against a plan of 48.0%, the project is 25.4% ahead (SPI 1.53). This week it gained 0.77% against 1.00% planned, so the lead narrowed slightly. Yet the schedule now forecasts completion 191 days after the contract date, one week later than last week.

Well ahead on progress, but the forecast finish is six months late. Both the weekly report and the P6 update forecast completion on 27-May-2028, 191 days after the contract completion date of 18-Nov-2027, with −163 days of total float (−157 last week). Every open milestone slipped another 7 days this week. Roads and medium voltage, the WBS that is behind plan (73.5% against 100%, unchanged this week), depends on the MV network, which is waiting for the MODON–SEC agreement; MV cable, ring main units and lighting substations have not been ordered.

Data notes

Built from the 27-Oct-2026 weekly upload (W04), with the 20-Oct-2026 upload (W03) for this week's changes.

  • Week number: the report states week 48.86 (whole weeks since site handover: 48); the file reference is WPR-049.
  • Physical progress differs between sheets: the dashboard shows 73.4% (524,368 of 714,561 man-hours), while the P6 export and the Physical-Chart Data sheet show 74.8% (534,438 man-hours).
  • The weekly summary file (works executed this week) and the Look Ahead and Conclusion sheets label cost-based progress as "actual"; this report uses physical % complete (man-hours) only. The weekly summary file also gives project code JDH3-03-011, contract value 86,742,345 and an expected finish of 30-Nov-2026, as does the Look Ahead sheet; the dashboard and P6 forecast 27-May-2028.
  • MODON PM: Eng. Abdallah Aljulayfi in the General Information sheet; م. رضا المنشاوي in the Look Ahead sheet and the weekly summary file.
  • Milestones: P6 and the weekly report still swap the roads/MV and deep-network forecast dates, and the dashboard's "Original (Baseline)" column shows latest-plan dates.
  • Asphalt wearing course: the Major Quantities sheet shows 4,025.6 m³ laid and the Material Monitoring sheet 4,025.6 m³ delivered, but its "installed" column still shows 2,074 m³. The installed quantity of the 6,115 m low-voltage cable line fell from 2,063 m to 230 m.
  • Schedule statistics do not add up: 1,278 completed + 198 in progress + 419 not started = 1,895, not 1,905. The "last week" failed-start count is 107, although the 20-Oct report gave 113 for that week.
  • The October manpower actual was revised from 130 to 182 between the two reports. The HSE sheet repeats 9,216 man-hours for this week, the same as last week.
  • The Procurement Log is unchanged from the 20-Oct upload (identical file). The Progress Certificate and the 3-week look-ahead PDF were not included in this upload.
  • Invoices: the summary says 6 submitted invoices, but the log lists 7 and the 44,851,849 total includes the seventh. Approved and paid amounts include 15% VAT, while the submitted total is gross.
  • HDPE pipes: the Major Quantities sheet does not name the network; potable water and TSE are inferred from quantities, and installed quantities differ from the Material Monitoring sheet.
  • Equipment cumulative actual stays at 564 from July although monthly counts continue. Several dashboard cells show #REF! errors.
